versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Cuckoos hide Eggs on enemy units that hatch into Chicks sized by their hosts when a fight clock strikes.
Dormice sleep through the fight's opening, safe, and wake bigger; both can lend themselves to other tribes.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Spelled out the timing the reviewers found unclear: Ottilie's delayed effects, Little Gernegroß's fate when his host dies, and when innate sleepers fall asleep.
Gave the Tier 1 Fledgling's Chick +1/+1 so the Egg side shows early, and settled two small cases on Nest-Box Dormouse and Frau Wechselbalg.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Closed the last rules gaps: Wind now works with the Tower's faster Hour, sleepers are absent to enemy targeting, falling Asleep doesn't wait for Ottilie, and a hidden Gernegroß hatches if you have nothing else left.
Shortened Ottilie's text so it reads at a glance, made the Journeyman's reach plain, and let the Herald pay a second gold when the Hour strikes three times.
